subject.title: Telegram: collapse mid-paragraph newlines before sending

question: Should Telegram collapse single soft line breaks in outbound prose/list text by default, only behind an explicit opt-in config option, or keep preserving author/model newlines?
rationale: Current source and related issues show intentional newline preservation in both plain and rich Telegram paths, while the proposed behavior would either change existing output defaults or add compatibility-sensitive config surface.

options.title: Add Opt-In Normalization
options.body: Add a Telegram config-controlled soft-wrap collapse mode with conservative default-off behavior and focused formatter/send/docs coverage.

options.title: Make Collapse Default
options.body: Change Telegram outbound formatting globally, accepting the risk that existing users who rely on single visible line breaks will see different output.

options.title: Keep Preserving Newlines
options.body: Close or deprioritize the request and keep current Telegram behavior aligned with newline-preservation reports and rich-message fixes.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Normalization
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram config-controlled soft-wrap collapse mode with conservative default-off behavior and focused formatter/send/docs coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus has the strongest recent history on the rich Telegram rendering boundary that would need to absorb or reject this policy.
